feature.name: Create and edit a stream
feature.description: Creates or changes a stream: a business process with stages, KPIs and workflows per stage.

requirements.text: Streams are saved as YAML in streams/
A stage runs existing workflows and waits for events something emits

acceptance.text: Stream schema, unknown workflows and unknown stage events are reported

decisions.decision: Streams stay and are validated: schema, stage workflows, stage events
decisions.reason: They describe the business process the workflows serve
